nodes.label: Chiseled Deepslate Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style chiseled deepslate block texture. Shows a dark grey stone face with a carved/chiseled decorative motif — typically a circular or ammonite-like fossil embossed pattern at the center surrounded by a beveled border frame. Color palette: dark grey, near-black, with slightly lighter grey highlights on the carved relief. Used as a decorative stonework block in cave or dungeon environments.
